title: Exhaustive classification of small three-fold spaces
claim: Exhaustive SAT classification (sound lexicographic symmetry breaking; CaDiCaL, replayed with Glucose 4 for n <= 12 and without symmetry breaking for n <= 9) of connected cubic triple systems with three distinct points per line: for n <= 13 a system that is not 2-colourable exists only for n = 7 (the Fano plane, unique) and n = 13 (unique up to isomorphism: the Fano splice; point and line splices are isomorphic); with one twisted incidence, none for n <= 13. With the duality of SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001C: the knot's three-fold spaces (contacts three-fold with odd base count, distinct corner triangles) with at most 13 triangles are exactly the duals of the Fano plane and of the Fano splice, for any corner line; the 13-point system has three line orbits, and all 18 corner choices give gadgets exact at the knot with lambda(0) = 25. Phase-pure gadgets (contacts two-fold with one base incidence or three-fold with odd base count) number 1, 0, 2, 24, 256, 3248 for n = 1..6; none has a lock and none is exact at the knot.
failure_conditions: A SAT answer that does not replay with the second solver or without symmetry breaking.
A second isomorphism class at 7 or 13 points.
A corner choice of the 13-point system whose gadget is not exact at the knot.
A phase-pure gadget with a lock, or one exact at the knot, with at most six triangles.
foundation_claim_scope: Connected cubic triple systems with three distinct points per line, at most 13 points; their dual three-fold gadgets and the signed not-all-equal knot. Lines repeating a point (multigraph pieces) are outside the search.

validation.status: checked: SAT answers for n = 3..13, untwisted and twisted, replayed with a second solver (n <= 12) and without symmetry breaking (n <= 9); enumeration of all symmetry-broken solutions at 7 and 13 with isomorphism classification; 18 gadgets at 13 exact; phase-pure enumeration to six triangles; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: no overlap found (candidate local delta); the small cases are consistent with the known theory of sign-nonsingular matrices and even cycles (F7 unique strongly 2-connected, McCuaig 2000)
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
